title: Generalizing Markowitz Portfolio Optimization by a Quadratic Risk Measure
abstract: arXiv:2608.24449v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We show that the key optimization results of the classical Markowitz portfolio selection theory, originally formulated for variance as the risk measure, remain available in explicit closed form under a broader class of strictly convex quadratic risk measures. The proposed framework replaces the covariance matrix with an arbitrary symmetric positive definite matrix and allows additional linear and constant terms, thereby containing various models arising in transaction cost optimization, benchmark relative optimization, covariance regularization, and factor models. Closed-form formulas are obtained for the efficient frontier, the global minimum risk portfolio, the maximum Sharpe ratio portfolio, the Capital Market Curve, the tangency portfolio, and the maximum utility portfolio. In contrast to the classical Markowitz model, the tangency portfolio does not coincide with the maximum Sharpe ratio portfolio, revealing a new geometric phenomen

translated_title: 通过二次风险度量推广马科维茨投资组合优化
translated_abstract: 摘要：我们证明了经典马科维茨投资组合选择理论中的关键优化结果，该理论最初以方差作为风险度量，在更广泛的严格凸二次风险度量类别下，仍能以显式封闭形式获得。所提出的框架将协方差矩阵替换为任意对称正定矩阵，并允许额外的线性项和常数项，从而涵盖交易成本优化、基准相对优化、协方差正则化和因子模型中的各种模型。我们获得了有效前沿、全局最小风险投资组合、最大夏普比率投资组合、资本市场曲线、切点投资组合和最大效用投资组合的封闭形式公式。与经典马科维茨模型相比，切点投资组合与最大夏普比率投资组合不一致，揭示了新的几何现象。
tldr: 该论文将马科维茨投资组合优化推广到更广泛的二次风险度量，并发现切点投资组合与最大夏普比率投资组合不再一致的新几何特性。
en_tdlr: This paper generalizes Markowitz portfolio optimization to a broader class of quadratic risk measures and reveals a new geometric phenomenon where the tangency portfolio no longer coincides with the maximum Sharpe ratio portfolio.
